evidence.title: Country duo Dan + Shay nearly broke up at height of success when their communication faltered

occurrences.quote_span: "So, if we can meet somewhere in the middle, we can make this beautiful thing. Which is what happened in the beginning."
occurrences.speaker: Shay Mooney
occurrences.subject: Dan + Shay

occurrences.quote_span: After host Joel Madden pressed the duo for more details, Smyers explained that, after they landed the opening slot for Kenny Chesney's tour , they were excited but didn't know if they could do it since their relationship was in a bad place.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Dan + Shay

occurrences.quote_span: They ultimately decided, "We have to figure this out," even if it meant that they "call it a day and go out on this Kenny tour as our farewell tour," Smyers said.
occurrences.speaker: Dan Smyers
occurrences.subject: Dan + Shay

occurrences.quote_span: "We had that moment in 2021, and it was kind of like, all right, do we ride off into the sunset and celebrate our accomplishments or do, like, we have some maybe really hard conversations with each other and fix this?" Mooney said.
occurrences.speaker: Shay Mooney
occurrences.subject: Dan + Shay

occurrences.quote_span: Dan Smyers, 39
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Dan + Shay

occurrences.quote_span: Shay Mooney , 34
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Dan + Shay

occurrences.quote_span: Mooney explained that their biggest issue was that there "was just a communication stop," and they eventually "got to this point" where it was "just getting really tough."
occurrences.speaker: Shay Mooney
occurrences.subject: Dan + Shay

occurrences.checkable_against: Dan + Shay interview or podcast transcript
occurrences.quote_span: Country music duo Dan + Shay revealed they almost went their separate ways at the height of their success.
occurrences.speaker: Dan + Shay
occurrences.subject: Dan + Shay

occurrences.checkable_against: Kenny Chesney tour lineup records and Artist Friendly podcast transcript
occurrences.quote_span: Smyers explained that, after they landed the opening slot for Kenny Chesney's tour , they were excited but didn't know if they could do it since their relationship was in a bad place.
occurrences.speaker: Dan Smyers
occurrences.subject: Dan + Shay

occurrences.quote_span: Mooney later explained that he felt as if Smyers wasn't enjoying himself during the shows, noting that he felt like he didn't "know how to make you enjoy these things" and that he just wanted his friend to be happy.
occurrences.speaker: Shay Mooney
occurrences.subject: Dan + Shay

occurrences.quote_span: Smyers said they also established a new rule by which they let each other know when something is bothering them "rather than letting these things build up and boil and then it just explodes."
occurrences.speaker: Dan Smyers
occurrences.subject: Dan + Shay

occurrences.quote_span: The duo, composed of Dan Smyers, 39, and Shay Mooney , 34, admitted while on the " Artist Friendly " podcast recently that, at the pinnacle of their success, "there was unhealthy dynamics between both of us 'cause we process things a lot differently."
occurrences.speaker: Dan Smyers and Shay Mooney
occurrences.subject: Dan + Shay

occurrences.quote_span: In the end, they chose to remain together as a duo after they both apologized for their part in the breakdown of their relationship.
occurrences.speaker: Dan Smyers and Shay Mooney
occurrences.subject: Dan + Shay

occurrences.quote_span: He was later able to understand that Smyers is particular about "those details that people don't see" and would get upset when things malfunction during shows, for instance, if "the video wall was out," whereas that isn't as big of an issue for Mooney.
occurrences.speaker: Shay Mooney
occurrences.subject: Dan + Shay

occurrences.quote_span: The two decided to meet at Smyers' home to have a conversation, with Smyers calling that meeting "the most pivotal critical moment in our entire career."
occurrences.speaker: Dan Smyers
occurrences.subject: Dan + Shay

occurrences.quote_span: Smyers added, "He ended up staying at the house till like 3, 4 in the morning and just hashing."
occurrences.speaker: Dan Smyers
occurrences.subject: Dan + Shay
